purpose: Exploratory 28/91-day screen; production defaults remain unchanged.

tirex_2.feature_recipe: Univariate target history only; no covariates; use native 0.5 quantile as point forecast; clip final forecast at zero.

tabpfn_ts.license: tabpfn-3-5-license-v1.0 (non-commercial weights; separate production license required)
tabpfn_ts.feature_recipe: Local mode only; univariate target history plus package defaults RunningIndexFeature, CalendarFeature, AutoSeasonalFeature; no supplied covariates; median output; clip final forecast at zero. Past-only and static covariates are intentionally absent because the wrapper drops them.

execution_contract.first_action: one 28-day latest-window smoke run per model
execution_contract.full_screen_requires: successful native model smoke with exact pinned package/checkpoint, no fallback or degraded output
execution_contract.same_window_requirement: Candidate dates and actuals must match the registered baseline grid exactly.
execution_contract.no_tuning: No weight, feature, context, checkpoint or candidate changes after scoring.
execution_contract.failure_rule: Import, authentication, license, checkpoint, compiler, memory, shape, non-finite or date-alignment failures are recorded as blocked/failed and produce no scored candidate row.
execution_contract.decision_rule: Keep only as a confirmation candidate when its fixed 75/25 blend improves mean WAPE versus both naive and the frozen TimesFM blend at a horizon without worse absolute mean bias or a larger worst-window WAPE loss. Otherwise reject. Existing historical windows remain exploration only.
